title: pleurospermum govanianum
intro: Pleurospermum govanianum, commonly known as the Himalayan pleurospermum, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). The plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleurospermum govanianum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit hepatoprotective effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
